Treatment Summary
The patient presented after a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain and
stiffness consistent with whiplash-type injury. Over the cuorse of care, the patient
attended 21 visits, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and soft
tissue treatment. The course followed a typical pattern, with visit frequency tapering
as symptoms gradually improved.
Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of a cervical
soft tissue injury. Whether this specific collision caused the injury, however, is not
yet clear from the available records. The patient also received treatment for the same
body region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute
to the current complaints.
Billing records reflect the services rendered, with no repeated charges for the same
services on the same dates. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, and the patient will be
reassessed if symptoms change or new concerns arise.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
